title: Inside the Biophoton Core
subtitle: Subdivision of the core community into research strands.

info.label: Prepared by

info.label: Method
info.value: Leiden clustering at resolution 3.0 on the coupling subgraph.

sections.label: Summary
blocks: The true biophoton/UPE core is the sub-cluster where the seeds and core authors (Cifra, Popp, Van Wijk, Kobayashi, Pospíšil, Musumeci, Scordino) concentrate; the biofield/EEG/quantum-biology strands split into their own sub-clusters.
